name: gamemaker-kit
description: Game development workflow plugin for Claude Code. Falsify un-fun in HTML before touching the engine: 29 skills + 4 domain agents covering 4 axes (time / discipline / validation / integration). Playwright bots with 4 procedural personas + your own self-test gate, then a 6-stage HTML→Godot/Unity port re-validation. Domain agents wired into SKILL routing (v0.3). Project-level release-readiness checkpoint via /gmk-dev-complete (v0.3). v0.4-v0.6 completed three half-applied-standard sweeps with a structural pre-flight guard. v0.7 promotes Checks A+C to FAIL-level, adds line-level allowlists, three new checks (D kit_version / E template line-cap / F hook API version), Rule 16 kit_version read contract (shape d warn-only), and an opt-in pre-push hook. Second consecutive ACCURATE release. dev-complete is a checkpoint (recomputable), not an endpoint — release and live-ops remain out of scope by design.
